sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, the division's leaders with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent form of five consecutive wins, face a tougher test this coming week as they host Eccleshall at Sandbach Community Football Centre. Their most recent outing saw them defeat Eccleshall 2-0, with goals from Josh Fowles and Kyle Foley securing the three points despite playing with ten men for part of the second half after Robbie Hatton's sin bin.
divisionWide: The chasing pack remains competitive: Stafford Town (20 points) drew 3-3 with Cheadle Heath Nomads after going down to ten men, while AFC Bridgnorth (19 points) suffered a surprise 1-0 defeat to Brereton Social at home. Wolverhampton Casuals (19 points) claimed an away victory with a 3-1 win at Shawbury United. In the mid-table battle, Bilston Town romped to a 3-0 home win over Market Drayton Town, while Allscott Heath secured an impressive 4-1 home victory against Alsager Town. Barnton picked up an important 2-0 away win at Telford Town to remain unbeaten in the league. Elsewhere, Dawley Town won 2-1 away at New Mills, Wednesfield Community claimed their first clean sheet with a 1-0 away victory at Crewe, and Foley Meir host Widnes Town at Trentham Foods Stadium.
